notes: Checked by scripts/check-budget.mjs after every npm run build. The gates and targets are DURABLE-11's (QA_DURABLE.md): boot JS and render-blocking CSS gzipped at level 9 (KB = 1000 bytes), any chunk loaded on demand, and the service worker's precache. lazyOnly is STUDENT-15's: these modules must never be in a boot file (scripts/vite-plugin-budget.mjs writes the module map it is read from). The last three are curriculum stage 4's (GEOM-2 to GEOM-4): the transform and proof objects, which register with content/manip.js when the lesson loads them, and the transformations unit's generators, which load with its teaching (content/lazyGen.js); then the congruence unit's generators and the proof templates and reason bank they use (content/congr.gen.js, content/proofs.js), which load the same way. The student lane's own deltas over 5618298 (+6 KB JS, +0 KB CSS) measured its share on its branch; on the integrated app the gates above hold the whole first load, as that lane's notes said they would. Curriculum stage 4's review fix: the challenge tasks' stories and parts left the first load (learn/challenges/all.ts loads with the challenge screen; the first load reads only learn/challenges/meta.gen.ts, which scripts/gen-content-meta.mjs writes, and learn/content-split.test.ts walks main.jsx's static imports so that no task file comes back): boot JS measured 427.4 KB, under the unchanged 433 KB gate (it was 445.0 KB). The precache is the raw bytes of every file kept offline, which no lazy load changes: the three geometry units' teaching and generators make it 5.06 MB, so its gate moved by the integration rule the merger wrote on the main branch (16fde75, QA_DURABLE.md: the precache gate is not a ratchet, measured + 5%) to 5.31 MB; the merger re-measures it on the merged app.
